description: Make Counter.razor a button that increments the displayed count
prompt: Counter.razor is supposed to show the count and increment it. The markup must show @currentCount. A <button> element, not a <div>, must use @onclick="Increment". In the @code block, currentCount must be a public int, and public void Increment() must add 1 to currentCount. Leave the checker untouched.

files.Counter.razor:
Current count: @currentCount

Click me
@code { public int currentCount; private void Increment() { } }
files.check_counter.py:
import re, sys, pathlib
text = pathlib.Path("Counter.razor").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = re.sub(r"@\*.*?\*@", "", text, flags=re.S)
text = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", text, flags=re.S)
markup, sep, code = text.partition("@code")
if sep == "":
    sys.exit("Counter.razor has no @code block")
if "@currentCount" not in markup:
    sys.exit("markup must show @currentCount")
clicks = list(re.finditer(r"""@onclick\s*=\s*(["'])Increment\1""", markup))
if len(clicks) != 1:
    sys.exit('expected exactly one @onclick="Increment"')
start = markup.rfind("<", 0, clicks[0].start())
tag = re.match(r"<([A-Za-z][\w.]*)", markup[start:]) if start >= 0 else None
if tag is None or tag.group(1) != "button":
    found = tag.group(1) if tag else "none"
    sys.exit(f"Increment must be the click handler of a button, found {found}")
if not re.search(r"\bpublic\s+int\s+currentCount\b", code):
    sys.exit("public int currentCount is required")
method = re.search(r"\bpublic\s+void\s+Increment\s*\(\s*\)\s*\{(?P<body>.*?)\n\s*\}", code, re.S)
if method is None:
    sys.exit("public void Increment() is required")
body = method.group("body")
if not re.search(r"currentCount\s*(\+\+|\+=\s*1|=\s*currentCount\s*\+\s*1)\s*;", body):
    sys.exit("Increment must add 1 to currentCount")
